hypothesis.statement: Removing Hunyuan without replacing its independent geometry estimate would weaken the required multi-model comparison.
hypothesis.action: Evaluate legally usable open reconstruction backends and migrate the second slot to InstantMesh while retaining Hunyuan as a non-executable historical rejection.
hypothesis.expectedResult: TRELLIS.2 and a methodologically different sparse-view LRM can produce equally measured temporary candidates under the same Go render contract.

selected.method: single-image to generated sparse views to LRM mesh
selected.reason: independent failure mode, published code and weights, no South-Korea territory exclusion

notSelected.reason: revenue-threshold commercial licensing and single-view bias
useful lightweight fallback but weaker multi-view identity constraint
official community license excludes South Korea

decision: Keep InstantMesh as the legal second reconstruction estimator. Do not execute until its exact weight snapshot is downloaded, checksummed and run on a capable CUDA worker.
